source_scope: Only extracted Item 1, Item 1A and Item 7 of the six reports; not full-report or external-world coverage.
review_policy: Approved by explicit user confirmation. Frozen content; amendments require a new version. See review_record.json.
split_policy: Dev for tuning; test reserved for final frozen evaluation. Same corpus, disjoint authored fact groups and disjoint positive source chunks. Not company/document-held-out generalization.
relevance_policy: Source-derived, human-reviewed positives with exact-quote alternatives; alternative supporting chunks may remain incomplete. Unit/context groups may be jointly necessary.
evaluation_policy: Current retrieval metrics use flat relevant IDs; complete multi-evidence support additionally requires every evidence group, not merely HitRate. Negative cases are excluded from Recall/MRR and assessed in answer/refusal evaluation.
annotation_schema: SEC company/report metadata, reference answer, exact evidence, evidence groups, constraints and reviewed status
